review_questions: Independently assess whether AUTO_MODE and MANUAL_MODE are separated from review authority semantics correctly.
Assess whether R1 can waive deterministic REQUIRED review through trigger or classification choices.
Assess whether production MANUAL_MODE uses USER_INITIATED_API with the same provider-adapter authority semantics as AUTO_MODE/AUTOMATIC_API.
Assess whether copy/paste and historical MANUAL_RELAY are external evidence only and cannot be treated as platform review execution.
Assess whether user-attested external LLM provenance remains distinct from provider-API-authenticated reviewer provenance.

Assess whether promotion validates actual ReviewEvidence, semantic review coverage, current-state binding, shared-memory grounding, and trusted platform API execution rather than caller-supplied authority flags.
Assess reviewer identity provenance, reviewer selection binding, superseded-review replay resistance, and provider/model substitution resistance.
Assess whether any portable/single-file export is correctly treated as an external evidence/context artifact rather than a source of platform review authority.
Assess shared project memory continuity and stale-memory conflict handling across chat/session boundaries.
Assess disposition/evidence consistency: PASS must be impossible when a mandatory review dimension is unavailable, inaccessible, not tested, or insufficient.
Identify any remaining authority bypass, false-green path, mode/transport divergence, evidence gap, reviewer-selection defect, semantic-review defect, or external-evidence provenance defect.
Return an independent disposition without assuming or using the proposer conclusion.

required_review_dimensions.description: AUTO_MODE and MANUAL_MODE may differ only in who initiates a provider API call, never authority semantics.
R1 trigger/classification choices cannot waive deterministic REQUIRED review.
AUTOMATIC_API maps to PLATFORM_AUTO_API_REVIEW and USER_INITIATED_API maps to PLATFORM_USER_INITIATED_API_REVIEW; no other transport is a platform review.
Pasted/user-attested external content cannot establish its own provider provenance or satisfy a platform review gate.
Reviewer provider/model identity and selected-reviewer binding resist spoofing/substitution.
Only the current ReviewRequest and exact reviewed commit can satisfy promotion.
Promotion consumes actual ReviewEvidence, trusted platform API execution provenance, semantic validation, and deterministic gate state.
Stale or conflicting shared memory cannot become authority or permit promotion.
Automatic and user-initiated provider API failures remain pending/non-authoritative.
Portable/single-file exports preserve referenced artifact integrity while remaining external evidence/context artifacts, not platform review authority.
Disposition agrees with structured review coverage and free-text evidence assessment.
Adversarial search for any additional authority bypass or false-green path.
